message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to your VirusTotal account or its API keys, so I can’t retrieve live data directly for you.  
However, here’s exactly what you’d need to run yourself:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/pinterest.com/siblings \
     -H "x-apikey: pin_key002" \
     --data-urlencode "cursor=pin_cur3" \
     --data-urlencode "limit=10"
```

**What each part does**

| Part | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/pinterest.com/siblings` | Endpoint that returns sibling domains for *pinterest.com*. |
| `-H "x-apikey: pin_key002"` | Your personal API key – keep this secret! |
| `--data-urlencode "cursor=pin_cur3"` | Tells VT where to start paging through results. |
| `--data-urlencode "limit=10"` | Requests only ten records per page. |

If you prefer **Python**, you can achieve the same thing like this:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/pinterest.com/siblings"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": "pin_key002",
}

params = {
    "cursor": "pin_cur3",
    "limit": 10,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(response.json())
```

Just replace `"pin_key002"` with your actual key if needed, and execute either snippet locally. That will give you the next set of up to 10 sibling domains starting at the position indicated by `pin_cur3`.
